channel.title: somethingchan changelog
channel.description: release notes nobody reads, rendered by xslt.

item.title: v7.0.0 — imageboard edition
item.description: the faq is now /qa/, a css-only imageboard: threads, admin capcodes, greentext, quote previews, catalog view, three themes. added /ip/, where your ip bounces and dances. still 0 bytes of javascript.

item.title: v6.0.0 — lowercase edition
item.description: everything is lowercase now, even the comments. added /js, which shouts at browsers with javascript enabled, using zero javascript. added a css-only environment report.

item.title: v5.0.0 — kai edition
item.description: new look matching kaieklund.vercel.app. mit license (c) 2026 kai. added .git explorer, css clock, /qa/, code review simulator, museum of waiting. still 0 bytes of javascript.

item.title: v4.0.0 — the extreme update
item.description: added the lab (3d cube, pipeline, merge resolver, svg filters), rebase dungeon text adventure, 404 page, icalendar holidays, certificate svg. still 0 bytes of javascript.

item.title: v3.0.0 — the complexity update
item.description: added mathml, smil, xslt, popovers, image maps, and a csp that bans scripts outright.

item.title: v2.0.0 — css only
item.description: removed javascript that never existed. added flip cards.

item.title: v0.0.1 — pre-history
item.description: epoch. the void. a lone .git folder.
